related_questions.question: Will I feel better after 5 days of COVID?
related_questions.snippet: Recovering from COVID-19 is different for everyone. How long it takes you to recover is not related to whether you were in the hospital or how bad your infection was. related_questions.snippet: Takeaways. COVID-19 symptoms (if you have them) typically start 2-14 days after infection and clear up within a few days or weeks. The severity and length of illness varies from person to person, and there's no certainty about how long COVID-19 stays in your body.

related_questions.question: Is COVID still contagious after 5 days?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, COVID-19 can still be contagious after 5 days. People with COVID-19 can be infectious from 1-2 days before symptoms start and up to 8-10 days after symptoms begin, according to the CDC. While the majority of transmission occurs during the first 5 days, it's still possible to transmit the virus after that period.
